# netactuate_nke_kubeconfig (Data Source)

Reads kubeconfig content for an NKE cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_kubeconfig" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the NKE cluster

### Optional

- `expiration_seconds` (Number) Token lifetime in seconds (default 31536000 = 1 year, max 3153600000)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig YAML for accessing the cluster
